title.zh: 规定在《省级政府法》实施前为保和省政府征收的九千六百三十九美元六十五美分（墨西哥币）可由该省现政府用于省级事务的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT NINE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE DOLLARS AND SIXTY AND FIVE-TENTHS CENTS, MEXICAN, COLLECTED FOR THE USE OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL BEFORE THE ORGANIZATION THEREOF UNDER THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT, MAY BE UTILIZED BY THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT OF THAT PROVINCE FOR PROVINCIAL PURPOSES.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT NINE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-NINE DOLLARS AND SIXTY AND FIVE-TENTHS CENTS, MEXICAN, COLLECTED FOR THE USE OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL BEFORE THE ORGANIZATION THEREOF UNDER THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT, MAY BE UTILIZED BY THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT OF THAT PROVINCE FOR PROVINCIAL PURPOSES.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định số tiền chín nghìn sáu trăm ba mươi chín đô la Mỹ và sáu mươi lăm phần mười xu (Mexico), thu trước khi thành lập chính quyền tỉnh Bohol theo Đạo luật Chính quyền Tỉnh, có thể được chính quyền tỉnh hiện tại sử dụng cho các mục đích tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้เงินจำนวนเก้าพันหกร้อยสามสิบเก้าดอลลาร์สหรัฐและหกสิบห้าส่วนสิบเซนต์ (เม็กซิโก) ซึ่งเก็บได้เพื่อใช้ประโยชน์ของรัฐบาลจังหวัดโบฮอลก่อนจัดตั้งขึ้นตามพระราชบัญญัติรัฐบาลจังหวัด อาจนำมาใช้โดยรัฐบาลจังหวัดปัจจุบันเพื่อกิจการจังหวัด
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa sembilan ribu enam ratus tiga puluh sembilan dolar Amerika Serikat dan enam puluh lima persepuluh sen (Meksiko), yang dikumpulkan untuk kepentingan pemerintah provinsi Bohol sebelum pembentukannya berdasarkan Undang-Undang Pemerintah Provinsi, dapat digunakan oleh pemerintah provinsi saat ini untuk keperluan provinsi
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa sembilan ribu enam ratus tiga puluh sembilan dolar Amerika Syarikat dan enam puluh lima persepuluh sen (Meksiko), yang dikutip untuk kegunaan kerajaan wilayah Bohol sebelum penubuhannya di bawah Akta Kerajaan Wilayah, boleh digunakan oleh kerajaan wilayah semasa untuk tujuan wilayah

text.en:
The treasurer of the Province of Bohol is hereby authorized to receive from T. C. Woodbury,
major, Nineteenth Infantry, United States Army, commanding the forces in the Island of Bohol, or his
successor, the said sum of nine thousand six hundred and thirty-nine dollars and sixty and five-tenths cents.
Mexican currency, which was originally collected from taxes on cockpits, permits for fiestas, contributions,
cedulas, and so forth, and constituted the revenues from which the expenses of the provincial government
were paid prior to organization of the Province of Bohol under the Provincial Government Act, and to pay
the same into the treasury of the provincial government of Bohol. The funds so received and paid into the
treasury shall be available for general purposes of the government of the Province of Bohol established under
Act Numbered One hundred and seventeen, extending the provisions of the Provincial Government Act to
the Province of Bohol. The treasurer of said province is hereby authorized, upon receiving the money
aforesaid, to give proper vouchers therefor to Major Woodbury, and the receipt of the treasurer shall be
sufficient voucher to Major Woodbury, or his successor in command, for the disposition of the said money.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act proscribing the order of procedure by the Commission

in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 20, 1901.
